title: Downtown London Walking Food Tour
blurb:
London, Ontario is a small city with a BIG appetite!

Our tour guide will take you on a culinary vacation. Each restaurant stop allows you to sample authentic food and learn a little about a new country. You will feel like a world traveler by the end of the tour and won't believe that you are home in time for Wheel of Fortune!

All you have to pack for this journey is your appetite and walking shoes!

Come join us!
